title: Empty
description: Placeholder shown when there is no data to display.

props.name: icon
props.description:
`null` or `false` render no icon at all (the `icon` slot replaces the
default one)

props.name: title
props.description: Heading of the empty state (or the `title` slot); also becomes its accessible name

props.name: description
props.description: Description text (or the `description` slot); `null` hides it

props.name: size
props.description:
Switches to the unframed sized layout (transparent background, size-based
padding, icon and font sizes). Omit it for the classic surface layout

props.name: useSvg
props.description: Uses the built-in SVG illustration instead of the default icon

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the container (a number is in px)

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the container (a number is in px)

slots.name: default
slots.description: Footer content, e.g. an action button

slots.name: icon
slots.description: Custom icon, replacing the default one

slots.name: action
slots.description: Primary call to action (a Button, a link or a group of them)

vars.name: --empty-padding
vars.description: Padding (every size; defaults to the padding of the size)

vars.name: --empty-gap
vars.description: Space between the icon, title, description and actions (sized layout)

vars.name: --empty-icon-size
vars.description: Size of the illustration icon (every size)

vars.name: --empty-radius
vars.description: Corner radius of the framed (unsized) layout (defaults to --radius-sm)

vars.name: --empty-description-max-width
vars.description: Maximum width of the description (sized layout)

vars.name: --empty-icon-background
vars.description: Background of the icon tile (sized layout)

vars.name: --empty-icon-border-color
vars.description: Ring color of the icon tile (sized layout)

vars.name: --empty-icon-radius
vars.description: Corner radius of the icon tile (sized layout; defaults to --radius-lg)

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import { Empty, Button } from "minerva-design/vue";
const created = ref(false);
</script>
<template>
  <Empty
    v-if="!created"
    title="Create your first project"
    description="Start by creating a project to organize your work."
    ><template #action
      ><Button @click="created = true">Create project</Button></template
    ></Empty
  ><output v-else>Project created</output>
</template>

basic.title: Basic usage
